sections.description: Snapology Autumn Harvest to Holiday Lights
sections.programName: Snapology Autumn Harvest to Holiday Lights
sections.programDescription: Experience the best of the changing seasons in one exciting program! Start by celebrating the Bounty of Autumn, where kids will use LEGO® bricks to build bustling harvest festivals, intricate corn mazes, and even farm equipment to "gather" their crops. Then, transition into the wonder of the Holiday Season to build and code magical creations like a robotic gift-delivery system or a motorized Polar Express. Each project blends holiday magic with real-world STEM learning, giving your child the perfect mix of creativity, coding, and hands-on fun.

Learn the arts of character design and worldbuilding in this D&D focused class! We will operate as an adventuring party and play a modified version of D&D with built-in drawing mechanics. Students will learn about collaborative storytelling and worldbuilding, D&D character creation, how to bring their characters and worlds to life through visual art, and much more! No experience required; TTRPG newbies welcome! All supplies provided.

Learn all about the art of making comics! This class will cover comic basics and discuss topics including character design, storytelling, panel composition, and lettering. We may also discuss other forms of sequential art including book illustration and storyboarding. Students will complete individual sequential art projects in the format of their choosing. All supplies included.

Curious minds explore the outdoors through hands-on activities and nature-based fun while earning stamps across eight environmental fields. Attend one session in each field to complete the journey and receive a program T-shirt and swag bag.

Listen, look closer, and wander with purpose. This guided, one-hour hike shifts with the seasons, using rotating themes and hands-on tools to explore plants, animals, and natural features along local trails. Every trek reveals something new, even on familiar paths.

Interested in learning practical self-defense techniques in a low-impact setting? This workshop introduces the basics of personal safety and defensive movement using a wooden cane. Wooden canes will be provided for use during class.

Each session journeys to a different region of the world to discover unique landscapes, wildlife, ecosystems, and environmental connections to North Carolina. Through hands-on activities and exploration, participants will learn how nature shapes life across the globe while building curiosity and appreciation for the world around them.

In this hands-on course, students explore air-dry clay while learning basic tools, textures, and techniques. Each session, they create unique projects using sculpting methods and creative finishes. Projects may include sculptures, personalized mugs, and more. This class is ideal for young artists who want to express their creativity while building foundational clay skills. All supplies provided.

Discover the fascinating wildlife of Bass Lake Park through hands-on encounters and guided exploration. Meet our Animal Ambassadors up close while learning about their unique traits, habitats, and adaptations. sections.programDescription: Milestone Moves is a monthly educational series led by Realtor Freda Hamlett, designed to help seniors and their families navigate later-in-life moves and major life transitions with confidence. Each session tackles a different topic—from estate sales and downsizing to housing decisions and planning ahead—offering practical guidance, real-world insight, and a good dose of humor along the way. Whether you're a seasoned grower or a green thumb in training, come ready to learn, plant, and play!

sections.programDescription: Our Can Play Buddy Sports program needs YOU! This adapted sports program serves individuals with disabilities, including physical, cognitive, emotional, neurodiverse, and developmental, as well as those utilizing mobility devices. The program relies on volunteers from local athletic organizations, companies, community groups, families, and individuals, to support Parks & Recreation Staff by serving as additional coaches and buddies to cheer on and guide participants through stations in the Hunt Center Gym in this welcoming and inclusive program. All volunteers will receive structured guidance in the use Can Play’s curriculum and adaptation model to adjust rules, equipment, environment, and instruction so each participant can engage successfully at their own pace. Groups, please contact [email protected] or 919-557-9602.

Embark on a two-hour adventure with Environmental Enthusiasts, where we delve into the depths of environmental awareness and action. Designed for those aged 16 and up seeking to make a tangible impact on our planet, each session is a blend of education, hands-on application, and a challenge to ignite change.

Hunter Safety Education Course through the North Carolina Wildlife Resources Commission. The Hunter Education Course includes information about hunter responsibility, wildlife conservation and management, firearms, wildlife identification, survival and first aid, specialty hunting, and tree stand safety. The course is a minimum of six-hours and is accepted in every state and province in North America. All first-time license buyers must successfully complete a hunter education course before they can hunt in North Carolina or purchase a hunting license. There is no minimum age requirement to take the course, however the recommended age is 10 and up. Hours of class are 9A-5P on Saturday FREE! Register online at ncwildlife.org.

Is your child ready for their first nature passport? Children can come explore, learn, and discover at Bass Lake Park while earning special stamps to fill their Discovery Nature Passport. Classes cover eight environmental fields of study that include 24 nature topics. Each class is filled with exciting challenges and a curriculum aimed to enhance their knowledge of the natural world around them. After completion of the Discovering Nature Passport, your child is awarded a unique T-shirt and swag bag.

Come learn about insect anatomy and all the neat parts that make up different insects. Learn a simple process on how to preserve and start your own insect collection through pinning. Pre-registration is required.

Walk, talk, and explore with fellow seniors on the trails of Holly Springs! Each guided outing lasts 45–60 minutes at an easy pace, creating time to connect, share conversation, and enjoy seasonal sights like birds and blooms. Trekking poles and binoculars are available for added comfort and discovery. With a different path to explore each session, it’s a refreshing way to stay active, social, and connected to nature. Meeting locations are emailed before each trek.

Join our group as we adventure on exciting outings for seniors 55 and better! Visit interesting places such as museums, parks, historic sites, malls, restaurants, and special events. Travel and tickets for all events are included in the participant’s registration fee. Participants are responsible for the cost of food, shopping, and souvenirs during these fun outings. Please note: Some trips have specific “must register by” dates due to advanced planning requirements, so be sure to sign up early! Enjoy an afternoon of timeless music with the North Carolina Symphony! We’ll attend the matinee performance of A Rodgers and Hammerstein Celebration, featuring beloved songs from two of Broadway’s most iconic composers. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the magic of live music and classic Broadway favorites.

Enjoy a fun evening of inclusive BINGO in a physically and neurologically welcoming space! Whether you're a seasoned player or new to the game, come for the prizes, stay for the laughs, and connect with others in a relaxed social setting where all players are welcome to join the fun!

Experience the joy of archery in a welcoming environment designed for seniors. Whether you’re brand-new or returning to the sport, this program blends gentle cardio, strength, and focus at a pace that matches your comfort level. Guided instruction and provided equipment make it easy to enjoy balance, movement, and fun at any level.

When the sun goes down, the discoveries begin. Follow the glow to a moth sheet and see which nighttime visitors arrive. From tiny patterned wings to surprising colors and shapes, nocturnal insects reveal a side of nature rarely noticed. Guided observation and shared discoveries create a relaxed summer evening focused on curiosity, wonder, and the hidden life of the night.
